# Urban Landscape Supplies

> Family-owned landscape supplies yard in Wetherill Park, Western Sydney (NSW, Australia). Sells mulch, garden soil, turf underlay, sand and decorative pebbles in 1-tonne bulk bags (selected pebbles also in 20kg bags) to homeowners, landscapers and builders, with delivery across 66 Sydney suburbs. Delivery is quoted per job based on suburb, load and site access, and is confirmed with the customer before dispatch. Click & Collect from the yard is free.

- Address: 21/130 Hassall Street, Wetherill Park NSW 2164
- Phone: 0433 132 406
- Email: info@urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au
- Hours: Tue–Thu 10am–5pm, Fri 10am–4pm, Sat 10am–3pm, Sun 11am–3pm (closed Monday)
- Online payment: Square (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Trade accounts available for landscapers and builders.

## Products

- [All products](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/products): full range with current prices
- Decorative pebbles: [Regular Snow White](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/pebbles-snow-white), [Crushed Snow White](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/pebbles-crushed-snow-white), [Charcoal Grey](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/pebbles-charcoal-grey), [Charcoal Lava](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/pebbles-charcoal-lava), [Red Lava](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/pebbles-red-lava)
- Mulch & bark: [Premium Hardwood Chip](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/mulch-hardwood-chip), [Woodlands Blend](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/mulch-woodlands-blend), [Woodlands Natural](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/mulch-woodlands-natural), [Pine Bark](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/mulch-nls-pine-bark)
- Soil: [Garden Mix](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/soil-garden-mix), [Planter Box Mix](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/soil-planter-box-a), [Top Dressing](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/soil-nls-top-dressing), [Premium Turf Underlay 80/20](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/soil-premium-turf-underlay)
- Sand: [Sydney Sand](https://urbanlandscapesupplies.com.au/product/sand-nls-sydney)
